target.output: recovery-generation exclusive fence plus durable loser receipt
target.scope: same opportunity + same recovery generation + overlapping write scope

canonical_identity.problem: Two recovery workers can independently pass the pre-claim no-overlap check and both persist append-only recovery claims and STARTED runs seconds apart for the same stale opportunity and overlapping write scope. The current lease/retry primitives fail closed on known overlap but do not atomically elect one recovery writer across this TOCTOU window.
acceptance: For the same opportunity/recovery generation with overlapping write scope, at most one recovery attempt may cross the substantive STARTED/writer gate.
Concurrent losers persist an append-only collision/boundary receipt, preserve every claim/run artifact, and re-enter allocation without substantive writes.
The winner is determined by an atomic generation fence or deterministic post-claim election that is reconstructable from durable evidence, never by newest-wins.
Independent isolated recovery work remains parallelizable; the fence must not serialize unrelated opportunities or non-overlapping scopes.
A live or fixture race with two recovery contenders proves one substantive winner and one or more durable losers while late original returns remain reconcilable.

dedup_note: Narrower than the existing live normal-claim receipt proposal and complementary to the lease/retry stale/CAS implementation: this pin targets the demonstrated recovery-generation TOCTOU where two append-only recoveries both reached STARTED.
